jsesh.mdc
Class MDCParserFacade

java.lang.Object
  jsesh.mdc.MDCParserFacade
public class MDCParserFacade
extends java.lang.Object

Fa�ade for the Parser process for java. This is still a rather low-level system. It can't do anything without the help of a builder class. It's a brick for advanced programmers.

A number of useful simple parser will be provided for usual needs.

setDebug

public void setDebug(boolean v)
Set or unset debugging mode. If debugging is true, the system will print many information on the text reading process, most of which is difficult to understand if you don't know anything about parsing. So this is a programmer's help, not to be used for final programs.

Parameters:
v - Value to assign to debug.
